text: In books_info, "description", "categories" and "features" look like lists or dictionaries but are stored as strings.
"book_id" in books_info and "purchase_id" in review refer to the same books, although the field names differ.
Joining books_info.book_id to review.purchase_id needs a fuzzy join: the values do not match exactly.
Some queries need information from the "categories" or "details" columns of books_info.
